Building Collapse in Delhi's Satya Niketan Kills Five, Rescue Operations Underway

A five-story building with a basement collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan area, resulting in at least five deaths and multiple injuries. Rescue operations are ongoing, with NDRF and police teams working to clear the debris. Families of the missing are searching for their loved ones amidst the rubble. Modern equipment, including life detectors and search dogs, are being used in the rescue efforts, which have faced challenges due to narrow lanes and debris. Some reports indicate that the affected building housed students, with rooms often accommodating two to three individuals.
